boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten documented public destinations on nearby Pittsford corridors, each with one specific activity or feature to plan around.

cards.entity_name: William A. Carpenter Park at Port of Pittsford
cards.title: William A. Carpenter Park: Canal-side walkways
cards.subtitle: North Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the walkways and benches for a canal-side pause, then look for the Veterans Monument in the park’s upper area.
cards.short_summary: A small canal-side park with walkways, seating, and a Veterans Monument.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town lists walkways, benches, picnic tables, a boat dock, outdoor stage, and the Pittsford Veterans Monument at this 22 North Main Street park.
cards.source_title: Town of Pittsford Parks and Trails
cards.access_notes: Listed at 22 North Main Street; the Town states parks close at dusk.

cards.title: Copper Beech Park: Outdoor game tables
cards.subtitle: State Street and North Main Street corridor
cards.notes: Bring a small game or simply take a seat under the pergola; the park has game tables, café tables, and plaza seating.
cards.short_summary: A compact public seating area at the State and North Main streets corner.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town lists a plaza patio, shade pergola, game tables, café tables, seating, and food-vendor area at Copper Beech Park.
cards.source_title: Town of Pittsford Parks and Trails
cards.access_notes: Listed at 14 State Street and 10 North Main Street; the Town states parks close at dusk.

cards.title: Hopkins Park: Playground and open fields
cards.subtitle: Barker Road at Mendon Center Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the playground or open multipurpose fields for a daylight meetup, and check the seasonal closure before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A 9.6-acre park with fields, playground, and restrooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town lists two multipurpose fields, restroom facilities, and a playground at Hopkins Park, 5 Barker Road at Mendon Center Road.
cards.source_title: Town of Pittsford Parks and Trails
cards.access_notes: Listed at 5 Barker Road; seasonal closure is November 1 through March 31, and the park closes at dusk.

cards.title: Isaac Gordon Nature Park: Pond-side trails
cards.subtitle: Clover Street corridor
cards.notes: Choose the hiking trails for a daylight nature walk, keeping the natural pond setting as the focal point rather than treating it as a shortcut.
cards.short_summary: A 118.5-acre nature park with trails and a natural pond setting.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town lists hiking and cross-country-ski trails and a natural pond setting at Isaac Gordon Nature Park, 3450 Clover Street.
cards.source_title: Town of Pittsford Parks and Trails
cards.access_notes: Listed at 3450 Clover Street; the Town states parks close at dusk.

cards.title: King's Bend Park: Paths around fishing ponds
cards.subtitle: West Jefferson Road corridor
cards.notes: Walk the paths around the fishing ponds and stop at the lookout benches; reserve lodges separately only if your group needs an indoor space.
cards.short_summary: A 19-acre park with pond paths, a lookout, lawn space, and playground.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town lists pathways around fishing ponds, a lookout with benches, playground, picnic tables, and open lawn space at King's Bend Park.
cards.source_title: Town of Pittsford Parks and Trails
cards.access_notes: Listed at 170 West Jefferson Road; park closes at dusk, while lodge rentals are available until 10 p.m.

cards.title: Lock 62 and Erie Canal Trail: Historic double-lock view
cards.subtitle: Monroe Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the viewing area to examine the historic double lock, then continue on the listed trails for a short, daylight canal walk.
cards.short_summary: A canal-trail stop with a historic double-lock viewing area.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town lists a viewing area at a historic double lock and trails at Lock 62 and Erie Canal Trail, 3195 Monroe Avenue.
cards.source_title: Town of Pittsford Parks and Trails
cards.access_notes: Listed at 3195 Monroe Avenue; the Town states parks close at dusk.

cards.entity_name: Paul M. Spiegel Pittsford Community Center
cards.title: Spiegel Community Center: Recreation programs
cards.subtitle: Lincoln Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Check the recreation schedule before you go; this site combines all-ages programs with a playground, picnic tables, and community rooms.
cards.short_summary: A community-center destination with recreation programming and outdoor amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town lists a community center, senior center, recreation programs for all ages, playground, picnic tables, and the VanHuysen Community Room.
cards.source_title: Town of Pittsford Parks and Trails
cards.access_notes: Listed at 35 Lincoln Avenue; confirm program availability directly with the Town before visiting.

cards.title: Thornell Farm Park: Lighted courts
cards.subtitle: Mendon Road corridor
cards.notes: Plan an active stop around the tennis, pickleball, or basketball courts, or follow the jogging and fitness trail through the park.
cards.short_summary: An active recreation park with courts, fields, a fitness trail, and a sledding hill.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town lists lighted tennis, pickleball, and basketball courts, a jogging and fitness trail, fields, playground, and sledding hill at Thornell Farm Park.
cards.source_title: Town of Pittsford Parks and Trails
cards.access_notes: Listed at 480 Mendon Road; the Town states this park closes at 10 p.m.

cards.title: Great Embankment Park: Canal-view seating
cards.subtitle: Marsh Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the canal-view memorial seating area for a daylight pause, then explore the pollinator meadow or watch activity from the fishing pier.
cards.short_summary: A 12-acre park with canal views, native plantings, a pier, and playground.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town lists Bird Harbor and Pollinator Meadow, a canal-view memorial seating area, fishing pier, small-boat launch, playground, and trails at Great Embankment Park.
cards.source_title: Town of Pittsford Parks and Trails
cards.access_notes: Listed at 631 Marsh Road; the Town states parks close at dusk.

cards.title: Farm View Park: Multipurpose fields
cards.subtitle: Calkins Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the multipurpose fields for a planned daytime game or practice, and check the seasonal closure date before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A 19-acre park with three community multipurpose fields and restrooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town lists three community multipurpose baseball/softball fields and restrooms at Farm View Park, 1901 Calkins Road.
cards.source_title: Town of Pittsford Parks and Trails
cards.access_notes: Listed at 1901 Calkins Road; seasonal closure is November 1 through March 31, and the park closes at dusk.
